problem: Native PowerPoint inspection exposed two reader defects: selected-shape classification discarded inherited namespace bindings, and InkAction discovery applied action-only whitespace rules to unrelated native math MCE branches. Classic-comment and Designer/classification operation evidence was also missing.
changes: Resolve classification XML using the actual containing-owner namespace scope while retaining shape-local raw ranges. Capture the scope after opening the selected root so an empty preceding sibling cannot leave a stale namespace binding. No conventional-prefix fallback is introduced.

Record non-whitespace text/CDATA/reference violations per MCE branch, then apply those structural restrictions only when the alternate owner advertises InkAction capability. Record violations on all active enclosing branches so nested unrelated MCE cannot hide text in an actual action owner.

Add five indexed native-parent tests, one full-corpus InkAction evidence audit, and two targeted codec tests for namespace aliases/defaults/Strict dialect/shadowing and branch content/nesting behavior.

Correct stale feature-matrix API names and public Designer facade scope. Clarify existing classic-comment set behavior: it creates an absent graph; dedicated verbs update/remove existing records. Removing all records retains an empty author part. No whole-graph replacement feature was added.

verification_scope.classic_comments: Explicit classic comment graphs are added to the native navigation/review PPTX beside its existing modern thread and to a native passive-macro PPTM. Full model fields and eager/source snapshots retain Unicode text, dates, positions, IDs, names/initials and counters. Author/comment creation, comment update, ordering, referenced-author refusal, stable-identity/date validation, no-op/stale behavior and record removal pass. Only the selected classic parts change during scalar updates; native modern author/comment, slide and VBA payloads remain exact.
verification_scope.classification: Native first-shape owners start without classification and now read successfully with inherited namespaces. Header/Footer/Watermark/explicit None and removal are distinct, invalid shape selection preserves earlier staging, and exact no-op/stale behavior passes. Unit coverage additionally qualifies inherited aliases/default namespaces, Transitional/Strict dialects, an empty sibling rebinding and a foreign namespace lookalike.
verification_scope.designer: Native shape derivatives retain independent true/false design-element flags, drawing properties and Unicode tags. Explicit editable=true differs from omitted editable/effective false; a present empty tag collection differs from removed properties. Slide-level tags retain the native stable slide ID and exact relationship/part binding through nonempty, empty and removed states.
verification_scope.preservation: Changed metadata stages save/reopen, replay and exactly invert all OPC member payloads. Classification/shape Designer changes affect only the selected slide; slide-ID tags affect only presentation.xml. Shape ID/name/text/geometry, unselected shape XML, all unowned members and source files remain exact. Classic graph additions compare every original data member and complete effective unowned content-type/relationship graph while allowing only the declared graph files to change.
verification_scope.ink_action_scope: All 15 native PPTX-family packages, including the decrypted encrypted fixture, have no active/source 2014 InkAction anchors or namespace payloads. The two InkML roots are positively present. The native fonts/math/handout file previously failed on ordinary MCE text. Focused tests prove text, CDATA and non-whitespace references still refuse in actual action-capable Choice/Fallback branches, including nested unrelated MCE; whitespace references remain accepted.
verification_scope.limits: Classic/Designer/classification metadata additions are library-authored derivatives, not native-authored specimens or fresh Office acceptance. InkAction is a reviewed native fixture gap with no positive action-payload credit. No collaboration/Designer service, rendering, host classification, action execution, macro execution or external retrieval occurs.

specification_evidence.finding: Classification belongs to the selected shape nonvisual-property extension and its actual namespace; none/hdr/ftr/watermark are typed stored outcomes, not host classification actions.

specification_evidence.source: User-supplied local full specification and tracked Designer models
specification_evidence.finding: Design-element flags and drawing properties belong to shape owners, while Designer tag lists attach to stable slide-ID owners. Optional/default and explicit empty values remain separate.

specification_evidence.source: User-supplied local full specification and the tracked supported InkAction profile
specification_evidence.finding: An InkAction owner is a distinct MCE/contentPart/relationship/target/fallback closure. Ordinary MCE math text and native InkML payloads do not establish that owner or inherit its structural whitespace rule.

reproductions.observed: Reading classification of the first native navigation/review shape failed with Invalid(classification shape root is not PresentationML), because the selected span inherited its PML binding from the slide. The same diagnostic run also exposed unrelated-MCE text rejection in the InkAction audit.
